mapper.select: select date_format(order_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as orderDate, ifnull(sum(amount), 0) as turnover from orders where status = 5 and order_time between #{begin} and #{end} group by date_format(order_time, '%Y-%m-%d') order by orderDate

select date_format(order_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as orderDate, count(*) as orderCount from orders where order_time between #{begin} and #{end} group by date_format(order_time, '%Y-%m-%d') order by orderDate

select date_format(order_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as orderDate, count(*) as validOrderCount from orders where status = 5 and order_time between #{begin} and #{end} group by date_format(order_time, '%Y-%m-%d') order by orderDate

select od.name, sum(od.number) as totalNumber from order_detail od left join orders o on od.order_id = o.id where o.status = 5 and o.order_time between #{begin} and #{end} group by od.name order by totalNumber desc limit 10
